# Netherby Bus Depot - night service log, August 2026

One row per trip worked after 22:00; night_km is the distance run on that trip.

turns.prompt: Netherby Bus Depot pays its drivers a night supplement of 1.35 pounds for every kilometre run on a night service. What is the total supplement owed for the trips in the August 2026 log, in pounds, rounded to two decimal places? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
